title: Eiichiro Oda's message for ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet: told he couldn't play because he'd get too hooked; 'Fine, I'm buying it myself!'

sources.name: Bandai Namco on Steam, 'A Message from Oda Eiichiro Sensei' (image of Oda's signed message, English version)
Steam 'ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet is Finally Grand Opening!'

claims.text: Oda's message text (radio host praising Kairosoft; 'OH, THE KAIROSOFT!?'; told he couldn't play because he'd get too hooked; 'So, it's a fun game! (I think) Fine, I'm buying it myself! Is this supposed to be a promotion?!?!')
worldwide release 23 Oct; Steam 66 AED / 67 SAR

notes: Brief: kind official quote, chip رسمي. Template quote (fourth quote today, under the cap; card-led 2 of 6 at 11:30Z). Variety: ONE PIECE went out 22 Oct (Japan release); this is new official content (the creator's message), not a repeat; a plain 'out now worldwide' post was rejected as near-duplicate. Person: Oda is the news but publishes no photos of himself; no official or licensed photo exists, so the Reel shows his signed message (person rule 3). Visuals: framed composites (our 9:16 frames) of the message (whole card, the 'too hooked' passage, the closing line and signature) and four Steam screenshots over the blurred restaurant art; the announcement trailer is narrated throughout and its scenes sit in decorative frames with caption text, so not used. Sound: our bed (trailer narrated end to end). Sensitive: none. Report rule: sits between the jailbreak report (10:30Z) and Astro Bot (12:00Z).
